text.name: Olympic Summer 2008
text.rules: Record "summer of 2008". SAE spends 3 points. If SAE played this card, until the end of this turn, points spent by SAE count 1 more. If this card's event happens, remove it from the game afterwards.
text.history: The Beijing Olympics opened on 8 August 2008; the same week, Russian forces fought a five-day war with Georgia that ended in a ceasefire brokered by France.
